# The environment that .github/scripts/ty_ratchet.py type-checks tensordict
# against. ty's diagnostic count depends on the Python, torch and other
# packages it resolves imports against, so every package is pinned exactly and
# no optional dependency is installed. Changing a pin changes the counts: rerun
# `python .github/scripts/ty_ratchet.py --update` in the same PR.
#
# Install (torch from the PyTorch CPU index, everything else from PyPI):
#   uv venv --python 3.12 .ty-venv
#   uv pip install --python .ty-venv/bin/python --torch-backend cpu \
#       -c .github/ci-constraints.txt -r .github/ty-requirements.txt
ty==0.0.99
# The newest stable torch, CPU build.
torch==2.15.0+cpu
# tensordict's runtime dependencies (pyproject.toml), then what uv resolves for
# them and for torch on Python 3.12.
cloudpickle==3.1.2
numpy==2.5.4
pyvers==0.2.3
filelock==4.2.9
fsspec==2026.9.0
jinja2==3.1.6
markupsafe==3.0.4
mpmath==1.3.0
networkx==3.7
setuptools==84.2.1
sympy==1.14.0
typing-extensions==4.16.0
